paragraphs.source_en: Virtually all cigarette brands were making an effort to appeal to women. (Since most smokers were men, that's where the opportunity to expand the business seemed to lie.) Phillip Morris did just the opposite. They established the masculine position by focusing on a man's man, the cowboy. What's a Camel? Who knows? What's a Winston? Same answer. What's a Marlboro? A masculine cigarette that also happens to be the largest selling cigarette brand among women.
